query: Total sales in India for March
expected_logic: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(revenue), 0) AS total_revenue FROM sales_with_revenue WHERE country = 'India' AND order_month = '2024-03';
SELECT city, SUM(profit) AS total_profit FROM sales_data GROUP BY city ORDER BY total_profit DESC LIMIT 2;
SELECT region, SUM(revenue) / COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS aov FROM sales_with_revenue GROUP BY region ORDER BY aov DESC;

query: Which region missed its target in Feb?
expected_logic: WITH monthly_sales AS (SELECT region, SUM(revenue) AS actual_revenue FROM sales_with_revenue WHERE order_month = '2024-02' GROUP BY region) SELECT t.region, COALESCE(s.actual_revenue, 0) AS actual_revenue, t.target_revenue FROM targets t LEFT JOIN monthly_sales s ON t.region = s.region WHERE t.month = '2024-02' AND COALESCE(s.actual_revenue, 0) < t.target_revenue ORDER BY t.region;
SELECT product_category, SUM(revenue) / SUM(SUM(revenue)) OVER () * 100 AS contribution_pct FROM sales_with_revenue GROUP BY product_category ORDER BY contribution_pct DESC;

SELECT region, product_name, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales_with_revenue GROUP BY region, product_name QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY SUM(revenue) DESC) = 1 ORDER BY region;

WITH m AS (SELECT order_month, SUM(revenue) AS total_revenue FROM sales_with_revenue GROUP BY order_month) SELECT order_month, total_revenue, (total_revenue - LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_month)) / NULLIF(LAG(total_revenue) OVER (ORDER BY order_month), 0) * 100 AS mom_growth_pct FROM m ORDER BY order_month;

query: Revenue of top 3 customers per region
expected_logic: WITH cust AS (SELECT region, customer_id, SUM(revenue) AS customer_revenue FROM sales_with_revenue GROUP BY region, customer_id QUALIFY RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY region ORDER BY SUM(revenue) DESC) <= 3) SELECT region, SUM(customer_revenue) AS top3_customer_revenue FROM cust GROUP BY region ORDER BY region;
